review_decision: Do not use any new Nemotron preference as a strict training label from this calibration run. Four strict differences favor c05293ad based on building-complex/parking/road text that does not establish disaster impact in the photograph; the fifth favors 446d99e4 based on roof-damage wording, which lacks a matching selected impact tag and needs independent adjudication. Eleven pairs remain unresolved. Exact grade agreement was 9/15 (60.0%) with Qwen v12 and 10/14 (71.4%) with Qwen v13, excluding its one invalid photo; these are small calibration-set descriptive rates, not qualification scores.
c052_visual_spot_check: The image shows a large building complex and roads; no obvious inundated structures are visible at displayed resolution. Nemotron cites human-built setting, not disaster impact. Treat its grade 1 as unsupported for this preference review; the native flooding_structures label is a weak proxy, not confirmation of visible impact.
446_visual_spot_check: Nemotron cites a damaged roof. The source image has a prominent white-roofed structure; damage is plausible but not independently adjudicated. Leave this preference unresolved.
